decision: Keep fine NCC mode 5 as an opt-in research option of the frame API: coarse ncc_mode 6 with fine mode 5 on transfer mode 3 is the recommended CUDA frame setting for research runs. Coarse ncc_mode 7 and fine mode 6 stay an inexact ablation, about 4-11% faster but bit-identical on only 8/408 runs. Defaults, the core and the GUI are unchanged.

hypotheses.H3: held (t5 faster than k6 on 17 / 16 / 17 of 17 cases)
hypotheses.H5: held (4344/4344 CPU matches found, 0 extra; worst score 1.35e-5, center 0.00123 px, angle 0.00145 degree; 8/408 runs bit-identical)
